title: Great app!
body:
I’ve been using this app for such a long time now, and i absolutely love it! I use it for everything. This app has basically everything you need to keep yourself and your everyday life organized and structured, but the only thing missing is the possibility to check off a task for starting it, but without finishing (Like a two-step process, which many tasks are). Maybe it can be showed as a diagonal line across the checkbox-circle? 
I hope this will be developed some time and that more users will find that useful, if it isn’t already built-in the app and I haven’t noticed it?

body:

author: Solmaa

title: Todoist is standing between me and the edge of the cliff
body: I don’t care to remember life before Todoist. I don’t know how I even survived, I was a chaotic, stressed and manic person that was always scrambling. EVERYTHING is in todoist now, from my tasks to my packing list to my favourite wines to my wish list, and I’m super chilled. If you ever stop todoist I will enter an existential crisis. No jokes. I think this might be true love.
author: Auswegian

title: My favorite way to organize life
body:
I’ve been using Todoist for over 5 years now (paid version). Using it for everything from groceries and
appointments to managing work projects. It integrates nicely with other apps and syncs quickly between all my devices.

My favorite thing about it is that it feels like the developers care. Useful features, based on user feedback, are constantly added. Not all of them are right for me, but I can see how most of them could fit in a workflow.

Nothing but praise for this app!

title: Not so intuitive
body:
I just started  using it and i cant figure out how you plan dialyse activities and habits.

After a week. Ok just see info video(that I found looking around) and it's surprisingly easy in its use.

But I think the way to make habits and "reward system" could been a lot better. Like have an overview of it in main menu where you press what you done. Feel I must search a lot to find overview and progress. Progress do not define which assignments and habits(things to remember daily or weekly) that you done. Just many different lines . 

Also the overview is not very good. And it does not seem to work. It is just a list and do not change to rabble when I chose that. 

I think a 5abbke view of the whole week is better for overviews and planning.

But it's a some enough app, that works. Better than nothing. Thank you.

author: jesusfrik

title: Pay to try
body:
You have to pay for the most basic tasks. Looking for an app to help me with building habits and thought this would be good. But as a free-version app you can just stick to putting tasks manually into your phone calendar instead. You have to pay to get notifications and I could even find a “repeat everyday” button. 

This might be good for those who wants to pay straight away, but if want to try before purchasing, this is not it.

title: Kan bli enda bedre!
body:
Fungerer absolutt godt. Men kan være litt tungvinn i bruk. Konkret; 1) det burde være mulig å legge en oppgave til 2 (el flere) personer, slik at alle som er i prosjektet blir varslet om kommentarer. Dette synes jeg er en veldig viktig ting å kunne gjøre når det gjelder prosjekt styring. 

2) Det burde være mulig å se litt av teksten til oppgaven når man går inn og leser kommentarer fra andre. Hvis man har mange oppgaver, er det ikke lett å se hvilken kommentar som hører til hvilken oppgave. Det er kjedelig å måtte trykke seg inn på info på oppgaven for å sjekke dette. Tar unødvendig tid! 

3) Burde kunne sette opp punktlister og sette ord i bold og kursiv for eksempel. 

4) Det hadde vært flott med mulighet til å gi oppgave via taleinnspilling.

Why, todoist, why...?

Ønske: På mobilappen burde det vært et konfigureringsvalg: «Add new tasks on top of list». Fordi: Det kommer ofte inn småoppgaver som må gjøres (ferdig) før mange av de større, eksisterende oppgavene kan tikkes av. Min arbeidsmåte gjør at jeg ville brukt dette konfigurasjonsvalget.

title: Definitely one of the best todo apps
body:
I've been using this app for around a year now, and seen the constant improvements added to it. 
I've also used Wunderlist, Gneo and many others, but I came back to Todoist in the end. 

It takes some getting used to, so be sure to go through the tutorial, and you'll understand why this is different from the other apps. 

I highly recommend this to everyone that needs a digital memory extension and a light project manager.

title: Overraskende!
body:
Overraskende bra til å være så enkelt. Og enkelt til å likevell ha så mange muligheter. Har så langt gitt meg kjempe kontroll. Og det med engang. Med things og omnifocus som er de store, så tok det meg et år å sette opp og tilpasse systemet, samt klare å bruke det uten at det gav meg bedre kontroll.

Et stort pluss som av meg har vært altfor undervurdert, er at dette programmet/appen er tilgjengelig og fungerer på kryss av et stort antall plattformer samt i nettleseren.
